source_caption_text:
Pharrell spotted Tyler, The Creator cruising in his Ferrari F40 like it was just another day 😭🔥

Via; @pharrell 

Introduced in 1987 to celebrate Ferrari’s 40th anniversary, the F40 packs a twin-turbocharged V8, a five-speed manual and a claimed top speed of roughly 201 mph. Ferrari lists its 0–62 mph time at just 4.1 seconds, making it seriously quick even by today’s standards. 

It’s also a collector’s dream, with recorded sales averaging around $3 million, though individual values depend on condition, mileage and history. ￼

Getting spotted by Pharrell while driving an F40 is a pretty good day for Tyler 😂🏎️
